description: Ground truth for persona_review prompt — what good/bad reviews look like

input.review_criteria: Does the graph view help you navigate binary features?

cases.notes: A good review names specific UI elements, compares to IDA/Ghidra, and suggests concrete changes

expected_failures: Response is just 'PASS' or 'FAIL' without structured JSON
Weaknesses are generic like 'could be better'
Changes don't reference specific UI elements
No comparison to professional RE tools
cases.notes: The old hand-written prompt produced exactly this kind of garbage
